title: bug: VS Code plan review re-enables Approve after the task leaves AWAITING_APPROVAL and returns at the same revision; JetBrains latches
description: Repro (no pending approval needed): open the review at AA rev 4, then push PLANNING/WORKING rev 4 (or remove the task), then push AA rev 4 again. JetBrains PlanReviewApprovalState latches INVALIDATED (STATUS_CHANGED/TASK_MISSING), so Approve stays disabled. VS Code media/planReview.js disables Approve without setting `latched` on a non-AA updateTask or on taskRemoved, so the AA return re-enables it. Found during CQ-I06b (task-f2d3d553). The corpus's latched probe is a WORKING frame, so it does not cover this. Decide which client is right, then add a corpus row such as "lost, W 4, AA 4" or "task null, AA 4".

comments.author: worker-5ebbf433
comments.content:
Fixed forward in CQ-I06b round 2 (task-f2d3d553), not yet QA-approved.
- moe-vscode/media/planReview.js now sets `latched` on taskRemoved, and on any updateTask whose token is null: the task left AWAITING_APPROVAL, or its stamp is unreadable. This is JetBrains INVALIDATED parity, so a return to AA at the same revision no longer re-arms Approve.
- Pinned by corpus rows A23 (lost, then W 4) and A24 (task gone), via the new latched probe in both clients: AA at `rendered` must leave Approve unusable, and a click must send nothing. Scratch mutants that drop either new `latched = true` fail A23 and A24 respectively.
- This row can close once task-f2d3d553 is approved.
- Related residual, filed separately: task-5e816f2c. The panel keeps a pending approval through a PLANNING frame.
